name: STRM Probe Optimizer
description: Optimize native probing for versioned video STRM files. Linux x64 only. The same v0.1.0 ZIP passed full validation on Jellyfin 12.2.0 and targeted compatibility regression on 12.3.0; no 12.3 capacity or full-format claim.
overview: STRM probe optimization — Linux x64 / Jellyfin 12.2.0; targeted 12.3.0 regression

versions.changelog: First release. Native playback and scheduled checks, minimal fingerprints, shared probe concurrency; validated video decision and recovery scenarios.
